function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values — meaning 48 patients have more than one row in the dataset. The data dictionary says `sample_seq` indicates assay run number, and the row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier ones for the same patient.", "implication": "If I compute the mean baseline biomarker value using raw rows, I will double-weight the 48 re-tested patients. I must deduplicate on `patient_id` by keeping the row with the highest `sample_seq` for each patient before any analysis."}
function.name: note_finding
